facts.business: Williamson Magor & Co. Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) whose Certificate of Registration was cancelled by the RBI in 2022, and the company is currently involved in debt settlements and asset disposals.

auditor.name: V. SINGHI & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) Non-recognition of interest expense on secured borrowings from HDFC Bank (Apr 2021-Mar 2026) and unsecured inter-corporate borrowings (Rs 4,29,251 thousand in FY26); (b) Default in repayment of NCDs to IL&FS and settlement adjustments; (c) Default in payment of interest and principal on secured/unsecured loans; (d) Recognition of deferred tax assets (Rs 12,65,132 thousand) without meeting reasonable certainty criteria; (e) Unreconciled/unconfirmed balances of receivables and loan creditors; (f) Material uncertainty related to going concern as net worth is fully eroded.

key_risks: Net worth fully eroded; material uncertainty on going concern
Default on secured borrowings (HDFC Bank) and unsecured inter-corporate borrowings with unrecognized interest
Default on NCDs issued to IL&FS; asset disposals (Neemrana Land) underway for settlement
RBI cancelled NBFC Certificate of Registration; appeal rejected; writ petition pending in Calcutta High Court
Directors disqualified under Section 164(2) due to NCD default
Court injunction restraining transfer/alienation/encumbrance of assets (IL&FS suit)
Arbitration proceedings with InCred Financial Services (formerly KKR India Financial Services)
Unreconciled/unconfirmed balances of receivables and loan creditors
Deferred tax assets recognized without virtual certainty of future taxable income
facts.related_party_note: Disclosure on Loans and Advances with Related Parties forms an integral part of the Notes to Financial Statements for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 (both Standalone and Consolidated basis). Disclosure by listed entity and its subsidiaries of 'Loans and advances in the nature of loans to firms/companies in which directors are interested by name and amount': Nil.
